description: This file defines the class DMin, which implements the database minimum calculation function for a spreadsheet calculation library, including methods to evaluate the minimum value in a filtered database column based on criteria.

classes.name: DMin
classes.description: Class providing implementation for the DMIN database calculation function in a spreadsheet context, computing the minimum value in filtered database data.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the database minimum (DMIN) function by extracting the relevant column from the database based on the field parameter, applying filters based on criteria, and returning the minimum value or an error if applicable.
